source_row.extraction_instructions: One annual flagship meeting, not a listing: list_shells_override parses the homepage hero line (dates, city) into a single shell. Detail reads /registration/ (USD fee table, Advance/Regular/Onsite plus hotel-block discount columns) and /abstracts/ (Regular Abstracts Closes). Sessions live on EventScribe (Cloudflare) and are deliberately not scraped.

registry_comment: IDWeek annual meeting - flagship microsite, single shell per year, USD pricing table
concerns: Modelled as ONE conference; ~100 sessions on EventScribe (Cloudflare) deliberately not scraped.
Premeeting workshops (Oct 20, e.g. ID Board Review Course) not modelled as separate rows.

Pricing: 54 tiers; the hotel-block discount columns are labelled with a 'Hotel-block discount' suffix. Advance tiers flagged is_early_bird with no deadline date (Aug 1 is stated only inside the label).
Homepage hero date regex is format-specific ('Mon. D-D, YYYY | City'); if the site redesigns it returns no shells (logged).
Once the meeting is over, no shell is returned until the site shows next year's dates.
cpd_points None: site gives credits only via /ce-credits/, not parsed.
